paper_title: 2-Tier SimCSE Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings
caption: : Figure 2: Accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment, and STS tasks.
model_annotation: Figure 2 presents a bar chart comparing the accuracy and correlation performance of five different models across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (Sentiment Acc.), STS Correlation (STS Corr.), and Paraphrase Accuracy (Paraphrase Acc.). The models evaluated are Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, which are listed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the metric values, ranging from 0 to 0.8. For each model, three bars are displayed side-by-side, corresponding to the three metrics, with colors indicating the metric: light yellow for Sentiment Acc., light pink for STS Corr., and light blue for Paraphrase Acc., as specified in the legend. The chart shows that the 2-Tier SimCSE model achieves the highest performance in all three metrics, with its STS Corr. bar reaching approximately 0.81, its Paraphrase Acc. bar at about 0.79, and its Sentiment Acc. bar at around 0.49. The Single-task_baseline model shows the lowest performance across all metrics, with its Sentiment Acc. at about 0.53, STS Corr. at 0.50, and Paraphrase Acc. at 0.79. The other models show intermediate results, with the performance generally increasing from the baseline to the 2-Tier SimCSE model.
